citation: Czuba M, et al. Int J Mol Sci 2026;27:5234
protocol: Constant-workload test to exhaustion at the lactate threshold on a cycle ergometer in normoxia (FiO2 20.9%) after a graded test; lactate change, HR and mechanical work at exhaustion (read normoxia columns only; the 16.5% and 14.4% FiO2 arms are hypoxia)
population: 12 trained men (VO2max 64.2 +/- 2.9 mL/kg/min) and 12 untrained men (VO2max 44.1 +/- 7.4 mL/kg/min), printed separately
note: Normoxia column of a hypoxia study; lactate given as change, not absolute values; trained and untrained men in separate rows.
